text.p: Tropical Cyclone Freda, with 75 mph winds, is in the soutern Pacific near 26s/177e, moving south at 6 mph. It is expected to weaken and pass south of Fiji, threatning shipping only.
Tropical Cyclone Gretelle, with 50 mph winds, is near 26s/36e in the southern Mozambique Channel, moving southwest at 4 mph. It should remain over water this period.
Tropical Cyclone Pancho-Helinda, with 55 mph winds, is near 11s/91e in the Indian Ocean, moving north at 6 mph. It will turn to the west and strengthen this period.
Tropical Cyclone Iletta, with 50 mph winds, is near 18s/70e, moving west southwest at 3 mph, and will weaken this period.
There are no further statements at this time.
